# Paper evidence register

**As of:** 2026-10-27  
**Machine-readable source:** [`paper-evidence.json`](paper-evidence.json)  
**Generated by:** `python3 tools/paper_evidence.py --render` — do not hand-edit this file.

## What this page is

One row per paper cell, with the current verdict, the artifact that carries
the number, and the audit that records how it was produced. It replaces the
four competing evidence tables that had accumulated (the frozen manuscript,
`CLAIMS.md`, the 2026-10-19 evidence-grade table, and `todo.json`). Where this
page disagrees with a frozen surface, **this page is current and the frozen
surface is historical**.

**Win rule.** todo.json win_definition: a cell wins only if (1) the point estimate is better with a paired 95% CI excluding 0 at the cell's alpha AND (2) the (quality, NFE) frontier dominates at every rung with a better plateau. TIE is not a win.

**Canonical numbering.** Wave-310 (paper §7.2 / CLAIMS CLM-060). The Wave-135 headline-evidence numbering and the paper-data directory names are historical aliases; see taxonomy_map.

## Status at a glance

- Cells: **11** — 1 WIN, 7 OPEN, 1 BLOCKED, 2 SUPP.
- Frontier coverage: **1 of 7 R-level cells** have a complete (quality, NFE) grid.
- One cell (R5c, w16e1_5k) satisfies both halves of the win definition. Seven cells have a point reading but no frontier grid; that is the single largest gap between the evidence base and the paper's claim.

## Per-cell detail

### R1 — LineageFlow HMMER hit count

- **Protocol:** N=1000 per arm, NFE=150, 3 rounds, seed 42 (single-seed); GAP-69 profile-init at seeds 42/43/44; GAP-79 dose screen at N=200, seed 42
- **Point (WIN_SINGLE_SEED):** +117 hits (158 -> 275, +74.1%); per-record +0.1170; CI [+0.073, +0.160] (per-record bootstrap, seed 42); p n/a (per-record bootstrap CI excludes 0).
- **Frontier (UNMEASURED):** no grid measured.
- **Cell verdict:** OPEN — Point win is single-seed and metric-level (hit count); the family-identity half is still open.
- **Next:** GAP-79 confirmation at W0.5, N=1000, seeds 42/43/44 (stopped 2026-10-27; restart when the GPU frees).
- **Artifact:** verification_outputs/gap55-r1-nfe150-n1000/seed42/upstream_eval.json; **audit:** docs/audit/gap79-r1-family-lever.md.
- **Paper anchor:** §7.2 R1; §7.11 R1 row; **claim:** CLM-060 R1.

> Caveat: Single seed. The 3-seed profile-init arm (GAP-69) fires on the aggregate (8.06-8.46x) but fails family identity: PF00072 and PF00183 sit at 0.79-0.80x of the init-only control in every seed. GAP-79 round-2 screen lifts all three target families at W0.5 (PF00072 23/50, PF00183 14/50, PF02517 5/50) with the guard unchanged at 8/50, but the N=1000 confirmation was stopped before it produced a verdict.
